name: Isles of Scilly
description: Isles of Scilly are a small archipelago and ceremonial county approximately 28 miles off the coast of Cornwall. The islands are renowned for their subtropical climate, beaches, wildlife and distinctive island communities, with tourism forming a major part of the local economy.

places.name: Isles of Scilly
places.description: A remote archipelago off Cornwall's tip, England's southwesternmost point, known for a subtropical microclimate, flower farming, and pristine beaches.
